item.title: Help github just deleted me
item.description: Update I’m back! POV Big thanks for the kind words and whoever undid my (prob automated?) deletion and/or ban on Github. I’ve got a local copy of my subpar code and other random junk, so I’m happy. Will at the very least be mirroring stuff locally, and probably going to at least mirror if not migrate because I still have no idea what got me banished or if it’ll happen again.
